summary: ArcelorMittal sold ~23.9M Vallourec shares (10% stake) at €24.00/share via an ABB, raising ~$667M. Proceeds will fund share buybacks. The company retains 17.3% and a board seat, with a 90-day lock-up on the remaining stake. Settlement due 21 May 2026. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for buyback execution and market reaction to the partial exit.
